derivation:
by
  simpa only [orderOf, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
    (MulAction.zpow_smul_eq_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd (a := x) (b := (1 : G)) (n := i)).symm
explanation: Specialize the group action theorem to left multiplication on G at 1. Its minimal period is definitionally orderOf x. The candidate is independent: its proof uses the general action-period theorem in the same file.
